scripts.build: npm run build -w @mtg-commander/shared && npm run build -w @mtg-commander/api && npm run build -w @mtg-commander/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mtg-commander/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @mtg-commander/api" "npm run dev -w @mtg-commander/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mtg-commander/shared && npm run protocol:test && npm run gameview:test && npm run test -w @mtg-commander/manabrew-client && npm run test -w @mtg-commander/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mtg-commander/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mtg-commander/api && npm run typecheck -w @mtg-commander/web
